assets.subject: The red flayed ram-headed demon in the FIRST ROW of reference image only. Tall lean digitigrade demon with curved ivory horns, iron-black hooves, rib cage and ragged crimson sinews.
assets.attack: claw strike. Frame 5 crouches; frame 6 winds the right arm FAR back; frame 7 lunges forward with claw across the chest; frame 8 follows through low.
assets.rear: back of ram horns, red spine and tail
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art enemy animation sprite sheet for SIGIL BREACH FPS, not an illustration.
Reference image: character identity and palette reference only; select ONLY this character: The red flayed ram-headed demon in the FIRST ROW of reference image only. Tall lean digitigrade demon with curved ivory horns, iron-black hooves, rib cage and ragged crimson sinews.
Generate exactly ONE square transparent PNG containing precisely 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 equally sized square cells, no gaps, labels, borders or grid. Every cell has ONE complete isolated full-body character. Feet aligned at 90% of each cell, body centered at x50%, horns below y8%, all limbs and effects strictly inside their own cell, same character scale in all frames. Keep 8% empty alpha margin on every side. Orthographic view, no scene, no floor, no cast shadows, real alpha transparency.
Handcrafted readable 16-bit dark-fantasy pixel sprites with chunky 2-3px pixel clusters, limited unified colors (charcoal shadow, worn ivory highlight, burnt brass), avoid fine noisy texture. Dramatic expressive silhouettes and materially different poses; do NOT mirror identical poses. Fixed lighting from upper left. First three rows face camera (slight three quarter).
ROW 1 cells1-4: four-phase locomotion loop with big joint changes: left-foot contact with right arm forward; passing pose with feet together, left knee lifted; right-foot contact left arm forward; opposite passing pose. Cloth, tail and shoulders follow with delayed motion.
ROW 2 cells5-8: claw strike. Frame 5 crouches; frame 6 winds the right arm FAR back; frame 7 lunges forward with claw across the chest; frame 8 follows through low.
ROW 3 cells9-12: hit reaction chest recoiling with head thrown back; death first collapsing to knees; death second tipping onto side; final fully fallen corpse along bottom of cell. All registered to identical ground baseline.
ROW 4 cells13-16: four matching locomotion poses viewed FROM BEHIND, back of ram horns, red spine and tail. Same walking cycle as row1.
Constraints: exactly16 sprites, exact4x4 grid, consistent anatomy/handedness/scale/palette across cells; each pose fits its cell; no text, no checkerboard, no background, no bloom, no antialiasing. Produce clean usable animation assets.
